capabilities: find the shortest path between two notes
list all paths between two notes
render paths as an interactive directed graph
filter files in paths with a regex
adjust graph force settings and keybindings
disambiguation: Not about file system paths; it finds chains of links between notes.
extras: Warns that setting path length to 0 in a large vault may crash Obsidian due to mass node rendering; also installable via BRAT.
problem: Obsidian's graph view shows the whole link network but does not answer which paths connect one specific note to another.

relations.evidence: genericTextSuggester.ts and suggest.ts are taken from phibr0/obsidian-dictionary
d3ForceGraphWithLabels.tsis taken and adapted from examples in d3Gallery

summary: Path finder that computes the shortest path and all paths between two notes and renders them as a list or directed graph.
